title: Earthology
author: Albert Raphael
description: Earthology: Humanity Characterized by the Earth, Sun and Zodiac, with Prognostications from the Moon, by Albert Raphael, 'President of the School of Science' (London and New York: Raphael, 1901). A popular astrological character manual, it describes the personality, talents, health, fortunes and compatibilities of people born in each period of the year according to the Sun's place in the zodiac and the corresponding season and position of the Earth, framed as the 'science' of earthology. It also gives guidance on lunar prognostication: the Moon's phases and its passage through the signs as indicators for undertakings and daily life. It is typical of the mail-order astrology publications of the turn of the twentieth century and a period document of popular astrology.
